name: Sister Maren
note: A Grey Sister, chaplain on Tollhaven's quays, who says the drowned's names at the Quay Chapel (world doc v1.69 §3.7): the Tidemark's found companion (cleric). Holds the Drowned Mole's harbour office (floor 2) with a boathook, naming the drowned at its door; joins once the Harbourmaster falls. Her own chain is to come.
